stem: What is the best distinction between plant macronutrients and micronutrients?
choices: The terms describe the relative quantities plants require, not whether one group is important and the other is optional
Macronutrients are always more important to plant survival than micronutrients
Micronutrients are needed only during flowering
Macronutrients come only from fertilizer while micronutrients come only from water
rationale: Macro and micro refer primarily to the amounts required. Essential micronutrients are still necessary for normal plant function even though plants require them in smaller quantities.
